messages:
jess: Quick heads-up — running a staging experiment for backstop model selection ordering. Trying an ordered degrade chain: primary -> quantized-backup -> small-backup. Need input on probe ordering, header override semantics, and circuit-breaker thresholds.
kevin: Goal is keep 95th latency under 400ms for premium tenants while not exploding cost. Two quick q's: 1) header-based affinity (x-redwood-prefer) or route-level mapping for tests? 2) CB triggers: 5xx% vs queue-depth vs latency spikes?
olivia: For explicit tenant testing use header override. For automated degradation, route-level mapping is cleaner. Avoid making header sticky for proxies — leads to cache churn.
samuel: Telemetry asks: add a fallback_rate gauge, latency histograms split by branch, and a trace_id attached to probe requests so we can correlate fallback decisions. Also emit a reason tag for CB trips.
anya: Console UX: rollout page should show active fallback lanes, live fallback_rate, branch latencies, and an "abort canary" action. Also surface suggested probe timeouts and cost delta.
jess: Implementation thought: probe order should be conservative: 1) quick probe to quantized-backup with timeout 200ms, 2) if probe fails/falls back then attempt small-backup with 400ms timeout. Header format: "x-redwood-fallback: q-v2,small-v1" — gateway should honor order.
kevin: Config snippet for route policy (staging):
```
route: /v1/generate
  match: header or path
  degrade_chain:
    - model: primary-v5
      cb: {error_rate: 0.03, window: 60s}
    - model: q-v2
      probe_timeout_ms: 200
    - model: small-v1
      probe_timeout_ms: 400
  header_override: x-redwood-fallback
```
samuel: CB triggers: prefer multi-signal decision: (5xx_rate > 3% over 1m) OR (queue_depth > 80) OR (p99_latency > 1s). When CB opens emit event with reason and upstream capacity tag. Also add automatic cooldown + exponential backoff for re-probes.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary pushed to staging for route=/v1/generate, canary_id=canary-2319, rollout=5% -> telemetry: https://internal.metrics/redwood/canary-2319
olivia: Billing note: keep quota accounting based on the originally routed model class (primary pricing) or explicitly tag fallback responses so finance can decide. We should add an opt-in flag for charging at fallback model rate.
jess: Edge case: fallback model returns a different structure (e.g., missing function call). We should add a response-normalization shim in gateway that enforces schema or flags regression. Also wire evals for a representative prompt set in staging.
kevin: I'll open a PR for header parsing + precedence rules (header should win if present, else route mapping, else default). Will include unit tests for probe ordering and timeouts. :thumbsup:
samuel: I'll own metrics dashboards: adding panels for fallback_rate, branch_latency_p50/p95/p99, fallback_reason_counts, per-tenant drilldowns, and a canary health overview.
anya: I'll mock the console changes — show canary weight slider, fallback lane list, live telemetry panel, and an "abort canary" CTA. Will include a note about suggested timeouts.
jess: Great. Sync tomorrow 10:00am to finalize thresholds and rollout playbook. Thanks everyone.
kevin: ack.
anya: ack.
olivia: ack.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Reminder: staging canary expires in 72h unless promoted or aborted.
